children: CHRYSLER (FCA US, LLC) IS RECALLING 82,843 U.S. VEHICLES - NHTSA

CHRYSLER (FCA US, LLC) IS RECALLING SOME U.S. VEHICLES AS IMPROPER BRAKE LIGHT ILLUMINATION, UNINTENTIONAL VEHICLE MOVEMENT, AND A LOSS OF DRIVER ASSIST FEATURES, SUCH AS ELECTRONIC STABILITY CONTROL, AUTOPARK, AND FORWARD COLLISION WARNING, CAN INCREASE THE RISK OF A CRASH.- NHTSA
